metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for handing GitHub issues and tasks to an agent

plugins.name: pr-flow
plugins.description: Hand off a task and get back a ready-for-review PR: land-the-plane, settle-pr, a local reviewer agent, and before/after PR screenshots

plugins.name: gh-orchestrator
plugins.description: Hand GitHub issues to the agent: a T3 Code broker starts a worktree thread per ready or assigned issue, wakes it when people comment, and leads large initiatives through sub-issues
